name: Moushooter
detailed_description:
About This Game

Moushooter is a shooting game that combines the thrill of a light-gun arcade shooter with the immersive storytelling of a visual novel. With simple and intuitive controls—just aim and click with your mouse—anyone can enjoy fast-paced, arcade-style shooting action. Hundreds of years ago, the Waroid army posed a deadly threat to humanity, but was halted when their energy supply was cut off. However, after a sudden “Energy Crystal Disaster,” 18 mysterious Energy Crystals have appeared, reawakening the dormant Waroids. The energy waves released from the Energy Crystals have rendered human weapons useless, and civilization collapsed in an instant. Amid the chaos, twin sisters and independent agents, Click and Aim, head to the battlefield on their own—no orders, no backup. Their mission is clear: destroy the Energy Crystals and shut down the Waroids once again. Experience high-speed combat with easy controls, emotionally expressive characters, fully voiced cutscenes, diverse missions, and intense boss battles—each with its own unique patterns and mechanics. Enjoy the best of both worlds: the pure excitement of a shooter and the emotional depth of a visual novel.

 Mouse to aim, click to shoot! A simple, nostalgic arcade shooter anyone can enjoy.

With simple controls that let you aim and shoot using just your mouse, anyone can jump right into the action. Easy to play, but demanding in timing and accuracy—this is arcade-style shooting at its finest.

Enjoy full voice acting and explosive bishoujo gun action!

Fully voiced characters enhance immersion, letting you experience their charm more vividly alongside the intense, action-packed battles.

Visual Novel × Light Gun Shooter

A seamless blend of emotional storytelling and intense gunfire action.

Experience the immersive flow of a visual novel combined with the fast-paced thrill of a light-gun shooter!

Varied missions unfold across every level

Each mission offers unique objectives and developments, delivering a tense and engaging gameplay experience.

Plug in your light gun and relive the arcade experience!

Connect a light gun for an even more immersive shooting experience—just like in the arcade.
